name: btc_daily_cost5bar_full_trend200vol
promoted_by: btc-signal-search (60-config walk-forward OOS grid, 2 datasets x 5 labels x 2 feature sets x 3 regime filters)

config.cadence: daily (UTC bars; signal on close, hypothetical fill next open)
config.label: cost_5bar
config.features: full (AR lags + momentum + trend + volatility + flow)
config.regime_filter: trend200+vol (close > SMA200 AND vol percentile in [0.20, 0.90])
config.model: LogisticRegression via LinearBTCModel, C=1.0, lag0=false, class_weight=none

sizing.derivation: risk $50 (1% of $5k) / 3% stop = $1,666.67; floor $500, cap 50% of equity
sizing.fee_model: IBKR spot crypto: max($1.75, 0.18%) per side, capped at 1%

oos_reference.judge: walk-forward OOS net backtest, 5 folds, 2019-2026 daily bars, real fees + slippage
known_weaknesses: most recent fold (2025-02 to 2026-07) was slightly negative (-1.19%)
edge is concentrated in bull regimes by filter design; bear/sideways are near-flat
12h twin of this config was NOT viable - do not run this at 12h cadence

reconsideration_gate.rule: no promotion beyond paper until one threshold is met AND paper stats support the OOS reference

do_not: change the 12h btc-eval default to this config
tune thresholds to improve paper results mid-observation
